raw.description:
About us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?
Your new role
The Business Platforms Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, optimization, and adoption of key commercial systems, specifically Gong (Revenue Intelligence) and LinkSquares (Contract Lifecycle Management).
The role also plays a critical enablement function, ensuring teams are trained, supported, and equipped to use these platforms effectively to drive consistent workflows, insights, and outcomes.
The role ensures these platforms are configured correctly, embedded into business workflows, well-governed, and delivering actionable insights to Sales, Customer, Legal, and Operations teams, as well as key stakeholders.
This is a hands-on, hybrid systems role, sitting at the intersection of multiple functions within Digital Science.

Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the US where we have an established legal entity.

If you apply from outside of this area, your application will not be considered.

Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

What you’ll be doing

Gong (Revenue Intelligence) Administration
  • Act as the primary system administrator for Gong
  • Manage users, permissions, integrations
  • Managing onboarding, offboarding and access controls
  • Configure call recording rules, trackers, libraries, and dashboards
  • Ensure data quality, compliance, and correct usage across sales and customer teams
  • Partner with key stakeholders to support coaching, deal reviews, and insights
  • Lead rollout of new Gong features and best practices
  • Explore, implement, and maintain integrations between Gong and other core business systems (e.g. CRM, Chili Piper conferencing tools, and analytics platforms).
  • Troubleshoot system issues and act as liaison with Gong support and a dedicated Gong CSM

LinkSquares (Contract Lifecycle Management) Administration

  • Act as the primary system administrator for LinkSquares
  • Manage contract repository structure, users, permissions, templates, and workflows
  • Support Sales, Sales Ops, Legal, People, and relevant key stakeholders with contract creation, review, and execution workflows
  • Maintain integrations with CRM (in collaboration with CRM team) and e-signature tools (e.g. Salesforce, DocuSign) and explore new use cases (e.g. vendor contract management and integrations (e.g. Netsuite)
  • Ensure contract data quality, tagging, and reporting accuracy
  • Support compliance, audit, and contract reporting needs
  • Partner with Sales Ops and Legal on improving reduction of manual work, turnaround times and contract visibility.
Cross-System & Operational Ownership
  • Own the end-to-end administration, governance, and integration of Gong and LinkSquares, ensuring both platforms are fully embedded into commercial, legal, and vendor management workflows
  • Define and execute the integration strategy across Gong, LinkSquares, and other core business systems to enable seamless end-to-end processes and data flow
  • Govern system configurations (including trackers, templates, clauses, permissions, and workflows) to ensure consistency, scalability, and avoid system sprawl
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, consent, retention, and audit requirements across recorded conversations and contracts
  • Monitor system adoption and effectiveness, partnering with, RevOps, Legal, Sales, and Customer teams to drive meaningful and sustained usage
  • Manage alerts, renewals, and key contractual obligations for both customer and vendor contracts, supporting risk management and cost visibility
  • Support reporting, audits, and insight needs related to contracts, conversations, and system usage
  • Maintain system documentation, SOPs, and user guidance, and support onboarding and training for new users
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve operational efficiency across systems
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to commercial, legal, and operations stakeholders
Enablement, Adoption & Change Management
  • Design and deliver enablement programs for Gong and LinkSquares, including onboarding, ongoing training, and feature releases
  • Create and maintain enablement materials such as playbooks, guides, SOPs, and best-practice documentation
  • Support change management initiatives related to new workflows, integrations, or system enhancements.

What you’ll bring to the role

Required
  • Experience administering Gong and/or LinkSquares (or similar CLM / revenue intelligence tools)
  • Strong understanding of commercial workflows (sales, contracting, customer lifecycle)
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and systems integration knowledge
  • High attention to detail and strong data quality mindset
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Operations
  • Comfortable in a hands-on, execution-focused role
  • Strong interest in emerging technologies and a demonstrated ability to drive adoption and meaningful usage across teams
  • Experience enabling and supporting business users on SaaS platforms through training, documentation, and ongoing support
  • Proven ability to drive system adoption and behavior change across cross-functional teams.

  • Identification of capability gaps and dependencies;
  • Development of engineering baselines and system-level requirements;

Language Proficiency

English: C1
